projects.name: Jev Score: request and scoring walkthrough
projects.creator: Jev Trader (web3w)
projects.description: An independent Jev Score walkthrough: complete System One request, ordered rubric and probability-weighted calculation. Explains why confidence is not accuracy. Static examples, not a live Jev call. From web3w's educational fork of jarrodwatts/jev-trader.

projects.name: FreeResume
projects.creator: Mohit
projects.description: Jev is used to judge each line of an uploaded resume against a set of narrow questions, then surface only the lines where the evidence is strong enough to act on, so users get a few specific, editable fixes instead of a paragraph of generated critique.
